description: This file defines functions and classes related to the functionalization pass in PyTorch's JIT, specifically for creating ViewMeta specializations and handling reverse/forward API calls for tensor view operations within the functionalization process.

methods.name: classname
methods.description: Generates the class name for a ViewMeta specialization based on the function schema, optionally including namespace.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Determines the operation name used inside forward/reverse implementations, considering reapply_views and namespace inclusion.

methods.name: reverse_name
methods.description: Generates the name for the reverse operation, optionally including namespace.

methods.name: returns_type
methods.description: Returns the CType representing the return type of a view operation, asserting it is tensor-like.

methods.name: is_multi_output
methods.description: Checks if a function schema might return multiple outputs.

methods.name: base_ctor_arguments
methods.description: Provides constructor arguments for the ViewMeta specialization, including symbolic inputs and output index if multi-output.

methods.name: extra_ctor_arguments
methods.description: Provides additional constructor arguments specific to the specialization, non-owning attributes.

methods.name: attributes
methods.description: Returns a list of bindings representing essential data for calling forward and reverse functions, including reapply_views and inverse_return_mode.

methods.name: op_arguments
methods.description: Provides the list of argument bindings for the operation, differing between forward and reverse modes, handling multi-output cases.
